about: Limits for scripts/client_qualification.py, per WebGL renderer class. A drag case is judged on its 95th-percentile step in milliseconds, a switch on seconds from the click until the new scene is drawn; null reports a case without gating it. The gpu limits are the interactive bar, 60 frames a second (30 for direct volume rendering). The software limits catch breakage on a GPU-less runner rather than promise a frame rate, and labels there are reported only: their extruded text is the cost, not the viewer. docs/client_performance.md gives the measurements.
